Chapter 6904: I Should Thank You

Chapter 6904: I Should Thank You

“Is that so?” Li Qiye chuckled.

“The inhabitants of Stygian can’t afford to lose this heart. If you are willing to return it, you will have our eternal gratitude.” Guangmai said solemnly.

“Hahahaha!” Li Qiye held his stomach and burst out in laughter.

The other immortals’ expressions darkened upon seeing the disrespect. Only Guangmai stared at Li Qiye earnestly.

Although he had fallen into the darkness, his immortal light was still magnificent. Others would mistake him for being from a different major world.

“Is it funny, Fellow Daoist?” He asked.

“Tears are going to come out, you’ve pretty much got all the laughter out of me for the next million years.” Li Qiye wiped his tears: “Only a brat would fall for your nonsense and believe that Devouring Alliance can stand for something so righteous. Oh, the shamelessness, I suppose that is worthy of respect in a sense.”

“Although our alliance is part of the darkness, it doesn’t mean we don’t exist alongside everyone else...” Guangmai said.

“Enough of this bullshit, we both know the truth but since I’m in a good mood, I won’t dwell on minor details.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“State your demands for the world’s heart. We will fulfill it.” Guangmai said.

“I have a simple one.” Li Qiye said.

“Please speak, we are listening eagerly.” Guangmai smiled.

“The removal of Devouring Alliance from existence.” Li Qiye said.

Guangmai didn’t become angry and glanced at the crowd. In reality, this demand was not a demand in his opinion. Devouring Alliance’s destruction was part of his plan already. Of course, he couldn’t be so direct right now.

“I’m afraid you will not only leave the world’s heart here, but also your life.” Immortal Devourer uttered coldly.

“Your demand is unreasonable, Fellow Daoist.” Guangmai spoke.

“I’m not here to negotiate, only to state the inevitable truth.” Li Qiye said.

“The truth? You appear rather confident.” Guangmai said, wondering if the heart could be this powerful.

“Perhaps I should thank you as well.” Li Qiye said.

“For what reason?” Guangmai asked.

“To eliminate all of you would have required a lot of time and effort since I couldn’t destroy this whole world. That would be ridiculous, right?” Li Qiye smiled: “Now, all of your overlords and immortals are together on one ship, thanks to you. It can’t get any better than this since I can kill you all in one go.”

“Bold words.” Extinguish sneered: “Not even a celestial immortal managed to destroy us, let alone you.”

“You’ll find out soon enough but please, take solace in that all of you will go to the yellow river together, it won’t be lonely.” Li Qiye said.

The crowd didn’t believe in the mortal’s threat. After all, they had survived even Heaven Pit.

“Is your confidence due to the world’s heart?” Guangmai asked, remaining calm to pry more information from Li Qiye.

“I can tell how much you want this heart.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Our whole alliance wants it, it will be a blessing for us and this world, granting life to all...” Guangmai said, speaking as if he were a savior.

“Oh, such moving words.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We will be using it to rebuild this world, it is the truth.” Guangmai was not lying.

“I believe you, this goal is not a lie.” Li Qiye nodded.
